metadata.question: Did the surface water area of Poyang Lake in China’s Jiangxi Province decrease between July 10, 2022 and August 27, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (cloud-free SAR) over a polygon covering Poyang Lake. Two windows centered on 2022-07-10 and 2022-08-27 with ±7 days; if empty, expand by ±14 days.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed. Classify water using VV backscatter threshold at -17 dB (linear ≈ 0.01995) on median composites.
3. Logic: Validate image counts and valid pixel counts (1 km scale). If collections empty -> C1; if valid pixels 0 -> C2; if any computed value is null/NaN -> C3. Compare water area (km²) between windows; decrease => A else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[115.8, 29.9], [116.9, 29.9], [116.9, 28.6], [115.8, 28.6], [115.8, 29.9]]],
    null, false
  );
  const SCALE = 1000; // per guidance to avoid timeouts
  const date1 = ee.Date('2022-07-10');
  const date2 = ee.Date('2022-08-27');
  const w = 7;   // primary half-window (days)
  const w2 = 21; // fallback half-window (days)

  const thrDb = -17;
  const thrLin = ee.Number(10).pow(ee.Number(thrDb).divide(10)); // linear threshold

  // Helper: evaluate EE object
  const evaluate = (obj) => new Promise((res, rej) => obj.evaluate(res, rej));

  // Helper: get S1 collection within window
  function getS1Col(centerDate, halfWindowDays) {
    const start = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-halfWindowDays, 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(halfWindowDays, 'day');
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('resolution_meters', 10))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
      .select(['VV']);
  }

  // Helper: stats for a window (with fallback)
  async function getWindowStats(centerDate) {
    let col = getS1Col(centerDate, w);
    let size = await evaluate(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      col = getS1Col(centerDate, w2);
      size = await evaluate(col.size());
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      return { images: 0, validPx: 0, areaKm2: null };
    }
    const comp = col.median();
    const validDict = comp.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom, scale: SCALE, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
    });
    const validPx = await evaluate(validDict.get('VV'));
    if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
      return { images: size, validPx: 0, areaKm2: null };
    }
    const waterMask = comp.lt(thrLin);
    const areaDict = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: SCALE, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
    });
    const areaM2 = await evaluate(areaDict.get('area'));
    const areaKm2 = areaM2 ? areaM2 / 1e6 : null;
    return { images: size, validPx: validPx, areaKm2: areaKm2 };
  }

  // Formatting helper
  const fmt = (x, d=2) => (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x)) ? 'null' : x.toFixed(d);

  try {
    const jul = await getWindowStats(date1);
    const aug = await getWindowStats(date2);

    console.log(`S1 Jul images: ${jul.images}`);
    console.log(`S1 Aug images: ${aug.images}`);

    if (jul.images === 0 || aug.images === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Jul valid px (1km): ${jul.validPx}`);
    console.log(`Aug valid px (1km): ${aug.validPx}`);

    if (jul.validPx === 0 || aug.validPx === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Check calculation validity
    if (jul.areaKm2 === null || aug.areaKm2 === null || isNaN(jul.areaKm2) || isNaN(aug.areaKm2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Threshold VV (dB): ${thrDb}`);
    console.log(`Jul water km2: ${fmt(jul.areaKm2, 1)}`);
    console.log(`Aug water km2: ${fmt(aug.areaKm2, 1)}`);

    const delta = aug.areaKm2 - jul.areaKm2;
    const deltaPct = (jul.areaKm2 !== 0) ? (delta / jul.areaKm2 * 100.0) : null;
    console.log(`Δ water km2: ${fmt(delta, 1)}, Δ%: ${fmt(deltaPct, 1)}`);

    // Final decision: Did it decrease from July 10 to Aug 27?
    if (aug.areaKm2 < jul.areaKm2) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
